definitions.explanation: A person's history of formal education, including schools attended and degrees obtained.

examples.japanese: {履歴書|りれきしょ}に{学歴|がくれき}を{書|か}く。
examples.english: To write one's educational background on a resume.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{学歴|がくれき}{社会|しゃかい}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Japan is said to be an education-focused society.
examples.notes: {学歴|がくれき}{社会|しゃかい} = society that values educational credentials

examples.japanese: {高|たか}い{学歴|がくれき}があっても{仕事|しごと}が{見|み}つからない。
examples.english: Even with high educational credentials, I can't find a job.

notes:
{学歴|がくれき} refers to one's formal educational credentials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {学歴|がくれき}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い (high/low educational background)
- {学歴|がくれき}を{問|と}わない (regardless of educational background)
- {学歴|がくれき}{詐称|さしょう} (falsification of academic credentials)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {学歴|がくれき}{社会|しゃかい} (credential-focused society)
- {学歴|がくれき}{差別|さべつ} (educational discrimination)
- {最終|さいしゅう}{学歴|がくれき} (highest level of education)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学歴|がくれき}: educational background
- {経歴|けいれき}: career history
- {職歴|しょくれき}: work history
